description: This file defines Dutch (Belgium) culture settings for the Date.js library, including localized names for days and months, date format patterns, regex patterns for parsing dates, and various utility functions extending the Date prototype for culture-specific date handling.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time components of the date to midnight.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date's time components to the current local time.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day of the week based on its name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month based on its name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specific month of a particular year.
